name: web_click_ref_snapshot
description: Click by browser_snapshot ref and bundle fresh browser_snapshot refs in the same result.

inputs.name: ref
inputs.description: Target ref id from browser_snapshot (for example e10).

inputs.name: element
inputs.description: Optional element label/context (e.g. the visible text or aria-label) to disambiguate the click target.

outputs.description: Click execution summary plus bundled browser_snapshot text.
Unique id for this bundled snapshot capture.
